newsitem.title: USA: Chicago plane has emergency landing in Philadelphia.
newsitem.headline: Chicago plane has emergency landing in Philadelphia.

text.p: A Chicago-bound United Airlines plane made an emergency landing at Philadelphia International Airport on Thursday after reporting hydraulic failure following takeoff, aviation officials said.
All 36 passengers and crew aboard Flight 437 landed without incident or injury, said Rick Ducharme, the Federal Aviation Administration manager at the airport.
"The United 737 experienced complete hydraulic failure shortly after takeoff," Ducharme said.
The pilot reported his problem at 6:42 a.m. (1142 GMT) and the aircraft touched down about 20 minutes later, said airport spokesman Mark Pesce.
The airline booked passengers onto later flights and the aircraft was being "thoroughly checked out," Pesce said.
